verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents some built-in automation that runs without manual effort: automated reminder emails to employees when receipts or memos are missing, and automated invoice payment and approval flows. These are thin marketing mentions with no detail on how users configure, trigger or monitor background automations. Scheduled payments are a one-off future-date action, not a recurring automation, and webhooks and the MCP server are building blocks for external agents rather than Jeeves-run automations. Missing for 10: a documented user-configurable automation or rules builder, recurring or scheduled background jobs, trigger and condition setup, monitoring of automated runs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Save time collecting memos and receipts by automating emails directly to employees when information is missing.
Automate invoice payments and approval flows
Track and control company-wide spending with automated tools.
